name: secrets-by-name
summary: Handlers never hold a credential: a named secret fetched at call time from a vault, a file or the environment, plus the redeemed-reference check

spec.document: CrossRiver AI Platform on AgentCore, design specification 0.21 (2026-09-16)
spec.replacement_test: The token vault serves the same names; a handler still refuses to run without a redeemed reference for its own audience.
